encoding.inputs: x, z, radius, heading and cone are the float32 values passed, float32_bits their bit patterns
encoding.rows: 113 rows joined by '/', where '=' repeats the row above
encoding.mask: 113 bytes a row, 1 = hidden; each row is alternating run lengths starting with 0s
encoding.texels: byte 2 (blue) of each image dword, 113 a row; runs of value*count, a lone value has no count
encoding.map: sight lists the cells with INFODATA bit 1 set, as [x, z]; every other cell, and every cell off the map, is clear
